Item_Vampire_Coating_Blood.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with the essence of blood. Your next primary attack inflicts <color=#C52443>Leech</color> and <color=#C52443>Vampiric Curse</color>, dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> magic damage after <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color> and spawning a <color=#C52443>Blood Orb</color>. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.

Item_Vampire_Coating_Chaos.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with blazing chaos. Your next primary attack triggers a <color=#e25dff>Chaos Explosion</color> dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> magic damage in an area and inflicting <color=#e25dff>Ignite</color>. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.

Item_Vampire_Coating_Frost.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with chilling frost. Your next primary attack triggers a <color=#03a3ff>Frost Nova</color> dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> magic damage in an area and inflicting <color=#03a3ff>Chill</color>. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.

Item_Vampire_Coating_Illusion.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with spectral energy. Your next primary attack triggers an <color=#37dfb9>Energy Burst</color> dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> magic damage in an area, inflicting <color=#37dfb9>Weaken</color> and granting <color=#E6E6E6>{stacks}</color> stacks of <color=#37dfb9>Phantasm</color>. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.

Item_Vampire_Coating_Storm.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with crackling thunder. Your next primary attack deals <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> bonus magic damage and triggers <color=#fdff5d>Chain Lightning</color>. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.

Item_Vampire_Coating_Unholy.descriptionTextEn: Imbue your equipped weapon with unholy corruption. Your next primary attack deals <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> bonus magic damage, inflicts <color=#4ddb00>Condemn</color> and conjures a bone spirit that circles around the target dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{spiritdamage}</color> damage and inflicting <color=#4ddb00>Condemn</color> to any enemy it hits. The on hit effect recharges every <color=#E6E6E6>{cooldown}s</color> and the imbuement lasts for <color=#E6E6E6>{coatduration} minutes</color>. <color=#82C9D9>Effect persists through death</color>.
